description: Enqueue up to 65536 payload bytes for a previously verified receiver using its delivery token. Returns a deliveryId, not proof of delivery. Reuse eventId and exact bytes on retries, then poll get_hook_delivery. The free allowance is 100 events/day per verified receiver; extra admissions consume purchased credits. No arbitrary destination can be supplied here.

bodyBase64.description: Canonical base64 payload, at most 65536 decoded bytes. Preserve exact bytes with eventId on retries.

contentType.description: Media type of the decoded payload bytes; JSON must be encoded as UTF-8 before base64 conversion.

eventId.description: Stable caller-chosen event identifier, for example order-20261007-01. Reuse with identical payload bytes on retry; different bytes under the same ID are rejected.

hookId.description: Hook identifier returned by registration; preserve for all subsequent operations.

token.description: Private delivery token returned by registration; authenticates event submission, delivery lookup and receipt verification for this hook.

name: accept_hook_event
title: Accept Hook Event
